items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Dink Pat his feet so loud, we got a pillar, and then we stood up on a pillar, and the pillar wouldn't do so we got a mattress.

ctx.x: Dink Johnson. Yeah. Dink Pat his feet so loud, we got a pillar, and then we stood up on a pillar, and the pillar wouldn't do so we got a mattress.
And last time we had... Dink Johnson was playing on...
How did you happen to pick him?
